indicator.showingAll: Showing all history, including records from before the reset on {date}

disputes.label: Dispute management
disputes.description: Dispute management counter: open booking disputes, escalated refund requests and escalated warranty claims. Also hides resolved disputes from before the reset in the dispute list.

cancellations.label: Cancellation requests
cancellations.description: Cancellation requests counter: pending cancellations requested by a professional. Also hides finished requests from before the reset in the list.

supportTickets.label: Support tickets
supportTickets.description: Support tickets counter: tickets and meeting requests that wait on an admin.

chatReports.label: Reported chats
chatReports.description: Reported chats counter: reports that are still pending.

reviewModeration.label: Review moderation
reviewModeration.description: Review moderation counter: published reviews submitted since the last reset.

bookingKpis.label: Booking KPIs
bookingKpis.description: KPI summary and breakdowns that count bookings in a date range.

warrantyClaims.label: Warranty claims (no longer reset here)
warrantyClaims.description: Escalated warranty claims are counted under Dispute management.

settings.title: Reset dashboards
settings.description: Reset a counter once its work has been looked at. After a reset the counter shows 0 and only counts items that arrive, or need an admin again, after the reset. Nothing is deleted.
settings.notSetYet: Never reset. The counter includes all open work.
settings.historyEmpty: No resets have been made yet.
settings.notePlaceholder: Why are you resetting this dashboard?
settings.noteHelp: Up to 500 characters. Saved with the reset in the history.
settings.confirmBody: The counter goes back to 0 right away. From then on it only counts items that arrive, or need an admin again, after this moment.
settings.confirmOpenItems: Nothing is deleted or changed. Open and pending items stay in their lists and can still be handled there; they just no longer add to the counter. Older finished items stay reachable with Show all history, and you can undo the reset.
settings.resetDone: The {dashboard} counter is now 0 and counts from this moment.
settings.resetAllDone: All counters are now 0 and count from this moment.
settings.undoDone: The previous baseline was restored for {dashboard}.
settings.error: Could not update the dashboards. Please try again.
settings.undoBaselineChanged: This dashboard was reset again by someone else. Refreshed — review before undoing.
